{{Resonator Tabs}} {{Language Tabs}} ==About Voicelines== {{VO |character = Suisui |language = en |vo_01_01_title = Thoughts: I |vo_01_01_file = {character}{language} Thoughts I.ogg |vo_01_01_tx = The clouds hang heavy with coming rain, and mist rises slowly from the water... See? What do you make of the dewy sights today? When I do business in {{Extra Effect|Mengzhou|Mengzhou|One of the six major cities in Huanglong, renowned for its abundant waterways, thriving greenery, and enchanting landscapes. Under the guidance of the local Sentinel, the Mengzhou people have developed unique Automata Mechanics.}}, I see weather like this often. A touch different from Xuanfang Hold, and nothing at all like the views in my hometown...

Perhaps each rainfall in this world has its own little temper. But it was this very drizzle splashing on teal stone slabs today that also fell on me decades ago. I heard its voice calling to me. And ever since, water has followed my will. It flows or rests at my command. And when I pluck the air just so, it comes to me, like an old friend.

Now I walk in the rain with no need for parasol or shelter. The raindrops know me, and I know them. |vo_01_02_title = Thoughts: II |vo_01_02_intimacy = 1 |vo_01_02_file = {character}{language} Thoughts II.ogg |vo_01_02_tx = Speaking of hometowns, my mind wanders back to my childhood in {{Extra Effect|Mingting|Mingting|The capital of Huanglong. The nation's political, economic, and cultural center.}}. Everything felt so impossibly soothing in the March spring breeze—the high grass, the soaring birds, and each dawn less heavy than the last. I often dragged Yangyang out to fly kites. I can still feel the exact moment the wind would catch them, the line snapping taut as if we'd actually hooked a cloud. To ensure my kite soared higher than everyone else's, I'd run as fast as I could.

The courtyard was filled with the chatter of birds, the rustle of leaves, and the sunlight... Oh, how it filtered through the branches like shattered gold, dusting everything it touched. Even after all these years, that remains the most beautiful thing I've ever seen. |vo_01_02_mention = Yangyang |vo_01_03_title = Thoughts: III |vo_01_03_intimacy = 2 |vo_01_03_file = {character}{language} Thoughts III.ogg |vo_01_03_tx = Springs back then—the wind oh so soft, the sky oh so blue, and a qin's melody oh so occasionally drifting over the courtyard wall. Our house never wanted for music. From dawn till dusk, it lilted through every hall and corner, enveloping me like running water. My parents, bless them, always knew I lacked the patience to sit at the qin and practice my technique. Yangyang, though, was my opposite. Even as a child, she could sit through an entire piece in perfect silence, her little hands tapping the rhythm against her knees with a solemn focus beyond her years. But me? I loved to slip away to some open ground and simply dance. A light tap of the foot, a swirl of the sleeves, and a well-timed gust of wind... In those moments it felt as if I could gather the very brilliance of nature into my arms. There was nothing more enjoyable than that. |vo_01_03_mention = Yangyang |vo_01_04_title = Thoughts: IV |vo_01_04_intimacy = 3 |vo_01_04_file = {character}{language} Thoughts IV.ogg |vo_01_04_tx = Beyond our courtyard lay an entirely different world. I was drawn to the docks, to the groan of ropes biting into wooden pilings as freighters moored, the shouts of vendors, and the rhythmic clack of abacus beads. To me, those sounds were more enchanting than any melody. I would crouch by the stalls and peer at ledgers, balancing accounts that weren't mine to balance or spreading out maps to correct a traveler's route. "This path is too long," I'd insist. "The river will save you two days." At first, the adults laughed it off as a child's game, until they realized I was right. My mother later joked to my father that perhaps their little girl had a natural gift for trade...
Well, what do you think? |vo_01_05_title = Thoughts: V |vo_01_05_intimacy = 4 |vo_01_05_file = {character}{language} Thoughts V.ogg |vo_01_05_tx = At first, I only saw the bustle, the lovely noise of it all. It was only later that I came to see that "peace and prosperity" aren't a given. They're fragile things, held together only by those who tend them. I decided then to be such a person.

I love this land, but I love the life humming within it even more. I could never settle for the safety of a quiet corner while others struggle. Still, I know the limits of one person's strength. I have seen villages hollowed by disaster and people who have lost their homes—the kind of wounds that no shipment of supplies can ever quite heal. These are realities I simply cannot change alone.

Tell me... if the day comes to stake everything on the future of this land, will there be someone to help me weave the vision I see? What I want is a world alive and thriving, and in you, I see the possibility of making that real.

So, if you're willing... take this path with me. |vo_02_01_title = Suisui's Hobby |vo_02_01_file = {character}{language} Hobby.ogg |vo_02_01_tx = Heh... the list grows longer by the day, I'm afraid. Lately, I've been quite obsessed with antiques and paintings. Even the little imitations from street stalls are fascinating in their own way, you know. There are certain tricks of the trade you only truly appreciate once you see them firsthand. I've even tried my hand at a few sketches. They're quite decent, if I do say so myself... Want to have a look? |vo_02_02_title = Suisui's Trouble |vo_02_02_file = {character}{language} Trouble.ogg |vo_02_02_tx = My troubles...? Money handles most of them quite tidily, thank goodness. All but one, that is: what to do now that my sister has grown up? Argh... when did she decide she didn't need me to hold her hand anymore? |vo_02_03_title = Favorite Food |vo_02_03_file = {character}{language} Favorite Food.ogg |vo_02_03_tx = Pastries, of course! Everything from the delicate pea flour cakes to those red bean rolls wrapped in white kidney bean paste. And then there are the soft, pillowy rice balls. Sweet without being cloying, simply melting on the tongue. I've also grown fond of the "Little Snowy Moons" here in {{Extra Effect|Mengzhou}}. They have this wonderful, subtle aroma within that chewy cake texture, entirely different from the flavors back home. One day, I really must bring some back for my family to try. |vo_02_04_title = Disliked Food |vo_02_04_file = {character}{language} Disliked Food.ogg |vo_02_04_tx = Despite my time in {{Extra Effect|Mengzhou}}, I still can't stomach the pickled local fare. It's a tragedy, truly. I'll see a dish that looks absolutely exquisite, translucent and perfectly plated, only to find I can't bring myself to take a bite. It's enough to make a grown woman sigh. |vo_02_05_title = Ideals |vo_02_05_file = {character}{language} Ideals.ogg |vo_02_05_tx = I want wealth that knows no border. I want goods to find their way, people to find their place. I want the warm light of every home burning, always burning, forever. |vo_03_01_title = Chat: I |vo_03_01_file = {character}{language} Chat I.ogg |vo_03_01_tx = Dumpling, over here! See? Isn't she a delight? Dumpling has a marvelous affinity for water. She whirls and chirps around me whenever I use my Forte to bend the currents... Mm, that's all it takes to make this little birdie happy. |vo_03_02_title = Chat: II |vo_03_02_file = {character}{language} Chat II.ogg |vo_03_02_tx = My family always let me do as I pleased, but choosing the way of the merchant was never a simple impulse. It began with watching and learning—observing how the street vendors set their rules and negotiated their deals before I ever dared to try it myself.

Oh, to watch the figures on a ledger slowly change, trade routes rise from nothing, and the cargo passing through my hands become the grain, fabric, or medicine that keeps another soul alive... That, my dear, is worth more than all the gold in the world. Commerce, you see, is not about calculation. It's about making a way for people to live. |vo_04_01_title = About [[Yangyang]] |vo_04_01_intimacy = 1 |vo_04_01_file = {character}{language} About Yangyang.ogg |vo_04_01_tx = Since we were children, people have said that Yangyang and I share only a face, that our spirits couldn't be more different. I was the one who needed to see everything the world had to offer, while she was the quiet, gentle center who kept her thoughts close. Over time, people even joked, asking if we were truly sisters at all.

Neither of us ever took offense. We knew that in all this wide world, you could never find two souls more alike. My sister may look soft and unassuming, but there is a resilience in her that runs deeper than anyone realizes. When you need the wind, she brings it to you. When you face the gale, she stands as your shield. This, I've always known. |vo_04_01_mention = Yangyang |vo_04_02_title = About [[Hsin]] |vo_04_02_intimacy = 2 |vo_04_02_file = {character}{language} About Hsin.ogg |vo_04_02_tx = Unlike the other {{Extra Effect|Sentinel|Sentinel|Wherever there is civilization and history, there will be Sentinels. They serve as mankind's guardians and conductors. Their immortal existence has helped humanity through countless troubles, sharing wisdom and prophecies. As humanity embarks on a new journey after enduring the Lament, the Sentinels remain as the record keeper and beacon in times of disaster.}}s of {{Extra Effect|Huanglong|Huanglong|Located at the edge of the continent, this country borders the sea to the east. It boasts a vast territory with one capital and six major cities.}}, Hsin doesn't feel like a divinity looking down from on high. Somehow, I see a part of her that's unmistakably "human." Maybe it's because I know how much she loves this mortal world that I dared to stand before her. |vo_04_02_mention = Hsin |vo_04_03_title = About [[Qingxiao]] |vo_04_03_intimacy = 3 |vo_04_03_file = {character}{language} About Qingxiao.ogg |vo_04_03_tx = One of my merchant caravans once spoke of a Transcendent who killed the Tacet Discords blocking their path through Xuanfang. That was Paragon Qingxiao. Between that debt and the support she provided during the Hold's defense, I felt it only right to thank her in person. With proper gifts, of course. But she wouldn't accept a thing. She only sat for a few cups of the tea I brewed. Wait, a tea favored by the famed Transcendent... Now that could be quite the selling point, no? |vo_04_03_mention = Qingxiao |vo_04_04_title = About [[Jingran]] |vo_04_04_intimacy = 4 |vo_04_04_file = {character}{language} About Jingran.ogg |vo_04_04_tx = The Cat of the Nether Lamp… the rumors make him sound like a ghost story. A figure in black, drifting through shadows with a Nether Lamp and the chill of the netherworld clinging to him. I've only met him a few times. Despite his youth, his eyes have the look of someone who has weathered storms that would break lesser men. He is utterly uninhibited, and it makes me curious: is there anything in this world that could actually hold him back? |vo_04_04_mention = Jingran |vo_04_05_title = About Mother |vo_04_05_intimacy = 5 |vo_04_05_file = {character}{language} About Mother.ogg |vo_04_05_tx = People know her as a master composer, but to me, she remains that gentle presence on the porch, pulling my sister and me into her arms on rainy days to tell us stories of the world beyond. I was always pressing her for what came next, while Yangyang would just watch her in quiet, wide-eyed wonder. Hehe, I suppose that was the rhythm of our childhood. |vo_04_05_mention = Yangyang |vo_04_06_title = About Father |vo_04_06_intimacy = 5 |vo_04_06_file = {character}{language} About Father.ogg |vo_04_06_tx = You couldn't find a more open-minded man in this world than my father. A teacher by trade, but never, ever the lecturing sort. He has a gift for tossing out witty lines with such ease that even the dullest classics become engrossing tales. I always laugh out loud over his letters. He writes with such flair that events happening a thousand miles away become just next door's news in his hands. Oh, you'll just have to see for yourself when you visit our home in {{Extra Effect|Mingting}} someday. Beautiful views, and I promise, the best tea you'll ever taste. |vo_04_06_mention = |vo_05_01_title = Birthday Wishes |vo_05_01_file = {character}{language} Birthday Wishes.ogg |vo_05_01_tx = Today is your birthday. Oh, naturally, I've had it marked.

I thought about organizing a grand banquet for you, the kind where the table bends under all those dishes and nobody is allowed to leave. But then it occurred to me that sort of merrymaking can be arranged anytime. Today, you should follow your own heart. Whether that means a lively crowd or a quiet corner with no one to disturb you, I'll make sure you get it. On a day like this, you're allowed to be a little selfish.

I'm a terribly "greedy" creature, I admit. I believe the best days ought to be savored slowly, and the sweetest meetings enjoyed long after the party ends. The world is vast and time is long. Whether you want a hall full of delicacies or just a quiet cup of tea, you need only ask me.

May every year be as bright as today. May you always follow your heart, and may every road you walk lead to the light. |vo_06_01_title = Idle: I |vo_06_01_file = {character}{language} Idle I.ogg |vo_06_01_tx = Watch closely, Dumpling... See? Quite lifelike, isn't it? |vo_06_02_title = Idle: II |vo_06_02_file = {character}{language} Idle II.ogg |vo_06_02_tx = May peace and plenty bless this land for good. |vo_06_03_title = Idle: III |vo_06_03_file = {character}{language} Idle III.ogg |vo_06_03_tx = (Effort sound) |vo_07_01_title = Self-Introduction |vo_07_01_file = {character}{language} Self-Introduction.ogg |vo_07_01_tx = If this isn't enough to pave the way, then let the rivers and mountains be the proof of what I'm willing to wager. |vo_07_02_title = Greeting |vo_07_02_file = {character}{language} Greeting.ogg |vo_07_02_tx = Where clear streams flow, there spring awaits. |vo_08_01_title = Join Team: I |vo_08_01_file = {character}{language} Join Team I.ogg |vo_08_01_tx = Exactly as I envisioned. |vo_08_02_title = Join Team: II |vo_08_02_file = {character}{language} Join Team II.ogg |vo_08_02_tx = This ensemble... rather interesting, I must say. |vo_08_03_title = Join Team: III |vo_08_03_file = {character}{language} Join Team III.ogg |vo_08_03_tx = Perfect timing, darling. |vo_09_01_title = Ascension: I |vo_09_01_ascension = 1 |vo_09_01_file = {character}{language} Ascension I.ogg |vo_09_01_tx = The sound of water... I hear it. Not from the streams, or the falling rain, but from somewhere far deeper. A resonance that seeps from the core of every living thing, waking the hills, waking the waters, one by one. |vo_09_02_title = Ascension: II |vo_09_02_ascension = 2 |vo_09_02_file = {character}{language} Ascension II.ogg |vo_09_02_tx = In the misty rains of Mengzhou, most people reach for their oil-paper umbrellas or scurry under the nearest eaves. But I don't mind the wet. I stroll leisurely through the rain while the droplets simply curve around my shoulders and drift away to find somewhere else to fall.... So stay close to me, darling. We've no use for umbrellas here. |vo_09_03_title = Ascension: III |vo_09_03_ascension = 3 |vo_09_03_file = {character}{language} Ascension III.ogg |vo_09_03_tx = I think the most precious thing in this world is the light that meets your eyes the moment you raise them. The first break of dawn, the river's surface glistening with flecks of gold, as fishing boats drift in small clusters to the rhythmic creak of oars. Then the markets stir. Bamboo lids lift, unfurling white breaths of steam carrying the scent of fresh buns. It mingles with the teahouses' distant melodies and the laughter of children at play... I don't just hear these sounds now. I feel the pulse behind them. A pulse threading together to form a rich tapestry that I cannot bear to lose. |vo_09_04_title = Ascension: IV |vo_09_04_ascension = 4 |vo_09_04_file = {character}{language} Ascension IV.ogg |vo_09_04_tx = People speak of commerce as if it's just buying and selling. But if you look closer, every trade route ends at someone's front door. Grain from the north. Tea from the south. Herbs from the mountains. Fabrics from the shores. Someone has to thread it all together, like a needle pulling a string, mending one land's scarcity with another's abundance.

These quiet exchanges are what have kept the world moving for generations. Water can wear down stone, or it can nourish a garden. Commerce can chase profit, or it can save a world. It's the path I've chosen. |vo_09_05_title = Ascension: V |vo_09_05_ascension = 5 |vo_09_05_file = {character}{language} Ascension V.ogg |vo_09_05_tx = The mountains and rivers are like a painting come to life. And this world, this bustling, breathing world, is so vibrant... but to witness it alone is a lonely thing. So... let's see the rest of it together. How big this world is, with its boundless wonders patiently waiting. For you. For me. }} ==Combat== {{Combat VO |character = Suisui |language = en |basic_1_tx = Spring's breath sings. |basic_2_tx = Clouds in sunglow. |basic_3_tx = Ripples dance bright. |basic_4_tx = Mist clears... |basic_5_tx = Chanties rise. |basic_6_tx = Homeward clouds... |basic_7_tx = Moonlit shoals. |basic_8_tx = A leaf ferries... |basic_9_tx = Verdant Hills. |heavy_1_tx = Waters chime. |heavy_2_tx = Drifting blue. |heavy_3_tx = Clear rivers. |aerial_1_tx = Verdure clings. |aerial_2_tx = Soaring green. |aerial_3_tx = Merge into one. |resskill_1_tx = Rippling splendor awakens. |resskill_2_tx = The water meets the sky. |resskill_3_tx = Washed... in nature's palette. |resliberation_1_tx = Mirrored by water, tinted in blue. |resliberation_2_tx = Clouds fade, clarity remains. |resliberation_3_tx = Beyond lush haze, the rainfall marches. |introoutro_1_tx = Follow the stream. |introoutro_2_tx = Into the landscapes! |introoutro_3_tx = Become the scenery. |introoutro_4_tx = My turn, Yangyang. |introoutro_5_tx = Ride the wind. |dodge_1_tx = You lost the beat. |dodge_2_tx = Flow like water. |dodge_3_tx = Keeping up, are we? |dodgecounter_1_tx = Aren't you a hasty one. |hit_1_tx = My oversight. |hit_2_tx = ...A misstep. |injured_1_tx = ...Almost wrinkled my gown. |injured_2_tx = That... I'll mark on my ledger. |fallen_1_tx = The world's sweet noise... I wanted more. |fallen_2_tx = Such beauty... so too must it end. |fallen_3_tx = This path... I'll walk no further. |esummon_1_tx = Come now. I could use another dancer. |etransform_1_tx = More stage time, perhaps? |enemynear_1_tx = Any new tricks? Do impress me. |glider_1_tx = World's warm breath, in my sight. |sensor_1_tx = No hiding from me. |dash_1_tx = The right momentum. |chest_1_tx = Good weight, good shine. |chest_2_tx = Seems the scales tipped my way, hm? |chest_3_tx = Mm, now that's quality. }} ==Change History== {{Change History|3.5}} ==Navigation== {{Resonator Navbox|type=voicelines}}
